Omarchy stage base for the mise builder (curl+tar toolchain) — based on the
REAL omarchy box so the whole check-charly-mise image chain is Omarchy. The
curl+tar toolchain comes from the shared plugin-mise curl-tar candy; the box
itself is local because the builder map resolves stage bases only from the
project's own box registry.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/plugin-mise/candy/curl-tar:v2026.242.2133`
